outgoing.name: East Africa
outgoing.excerpt: The Common Eland, or Southern Eland, (Taurotragus oryx) is a savannah and plain antelope found in East and Southern Africa.

outgoing.name: Southern Africa
outgoing.excerpt: The Common Eland, or Southern Eland, (Taurotragus oryx) is a savannah and plain antelope found in East and Southern Africa.
